note: Ask Primo help topics. Edit q, keys, steps or video (a YouTube link, or empty). PRIMO picks up changes next time it opens.

items.q: Turn on developer options (Fire TV)
steps: Press the Home button, then go right to Settings (the cog).
Open My Fire TV, then About.
Highlight your device name (e.g. Fire TV Stick 4K) and press the centre button 7 times, until it says you are now a developer.
Press Back. Developer options now appears in My Fire TV.

items.q: Allow Downloader to install apps (Fire TV)
steps: Install Downloader from the Amazon Appstore (search for Downloader).
Turn on developer options first (ask: turn on developer options).
Go to Settings, My Fire TV, Developer options, Install unknown apps.
Switch Downloader to On. You can now install apps with Downloader.

items.q: Turn on developer options (Android TV / Google TV)
steps: Open Settings, then System, then About.
Scroll to Android TV OS build and press OK on it 7 times, until it says you are a developer.
Press Back. Developer options now appears under System.

items.q: Allow apps from unknown sources (Android TV / Google TV)
steps: Turn on developer options first (ask: turn on developer options).
Open Settings, then Apps, then Security & restrictions, then Unknown sources. On some boxes it is Apps, Special app access, Install unknown apps.
Switch on the app you install with, such as Downloader or your file manager.

items.q: Fix buffering and freezing
steps: Restart your box and your router: unplug both for 30 seconds.
Use a wired connection if you can, or the 5 GHz Wi-Fi network, and keep the box close to the router.
In PRIMO, lower Settings, Preferred quality to HD, or press OK while watching and choose Quality.
Turn on Settings, Full-screen player for live TV.
Clear the cache of apps you use (ask: clear cache).
Check your speed (ask: internet speed). HD needs about 10 Mbps, 4K about 25 Mbps.

items.q: Clear the cache (Fire TV)
steps: Go to Settings, Applications, Manage Installed Applications.
Pick the app (e.g. PRIMO) and choose Clear cache. Don't choose Clear data unless you want to sign in again.
Newer Fire TVs also have Clear all application caches on the Manage Installed Applications screen.
Restart the Fire TV afterwards.

items.q: Fire TV running slow or low on space
steps: Restart the Fire TV: hold Select and Play/Pause together for 5 seconds.
Clear all app caches: Settings, Applications, Manage Installed Applications, Clear all application caches.
Uninstall apps you don't use from the same screen.
Turn off Settings, Preferences, Featured content autoplay to save memory.

items.q: A channel won't play or shows a black screen
steps: Press OK while watching and choose Quality to try another version of the channel.
Turn on Settings, Full-screen player for live TV, then try again.
Try another channel. If none play, restart your box and router.
If only one channel fails, it may be down at the provider's end — try again later.

items.q: No sound, or sound but no picture
steps: Check the TV and sound bar volume and that the right input is selected.
Fire TV: Settings, Display & Sounds, Audio, Surround Sound — try Stereo or Best available.
Try the Full-screen player (Settings, Full-screen player for live TV), which handles more audio formats.
Try another Quality version of the channel.

items.q: Can't sign in / login rejected
steps: Check the username and password exactly as given to you — they are case sensitive and easy to mistype on a remote.
Check your subscription hasn't expired.
Restart the box and try again.
Still stuck? Contact whoever supplied your login.

items.q: Stops when someone else is watching
steps: Most logins only allow a set number of devices to watch at the same time.
Close PRIMO on other devices (press Back until it asks to exit) when you're not watching.
Multiview uses one connection per screen, so four screens can use up four connections.
Ask your supplier if you need more connections.

items.q: TV guide is missing or says 'loading'
steps: Guide listings come from your provider and load a few channels at a time — give it a moment.
Some channels simply have no guide information.
If the whole guide is empty, restart PRIMO.

items.q: Watch from the start / catch up isn't available
steps: Watch from the start only works on channels your provider records.
On other channels the button is hidden, and Catch me up tells you the channel isn't recorded.
Use Time Machine to see what's on recorded channels earlier today.

items.q: Update PRIMO
steps: In PRIMO go to Settings, Update PRIMO and press OK. It downloads and installs over the top — your logins and favourites stay.
Or open Downloader and enter the PRIMO download link you were given.

items.q: Restart the Fire TV
steps: Hold Select (the centre button) and Play/Pause together for about 5 seconds until the screen goes off.
Or go to Settings, My Fire TV, Restart.
If it's completely stuck, unplug the power for 30 seconds.

items.q: Remote not working / pair the remote
steps: Try new batteries.
Pair it again: hold the Home button for 10 seconds, close to the Fire TV.
Use the Fire TV app on your phone as a remote while you sort it out.

items.q: Check your internet speed
steps: Install a speed test app such as Analiti or Speedtest from your app store.
HD needs about 10 Mbps and 4K about 25 Mbps — more if others are using the internet at the same time.
If it's slow, restart the router, move the box closer or use a wired connection.

items.q: Add favourite channels
steps: While watching, press OK and choose Favourite +.
Favourites appear first in the TV Guide, on Home, in Time Machine and in Multiview.

items.q: Hide countries and groups I don't watch
steps: Go to Settings, Countries. Press Hide all, then switch on just the countries you want.
Settings, Hidden channels & groups hides individual groups too.
Settings, One entry per channel shows each channel once instead of SD/HD/FHD/4K copies.

items.q: Watch several channels at once
steps: Open Multiview from the top menu.
Pick a screen, then choose a channel from the list on the right to put it there.
Sound follows whichever screen is highlighted. Press OK to watch it full screen.
Each screen uses one of your connections.
